message:
We've all had those family group chats where someone brings up the "what ifs" of an emergency, right? It's a good reminder that while we hope for the best, being prepared for the unexpected is something we can all benefit from. 💡  
This resource offers practical steps on financial preparedness, helping us think through what we might need in uncertain times. It’s always a good time to reflect on our plans, and maybe even share some tips with our loved ones. What’s one financial tip you’d share with the family to keep everyone ready?
